pages.text: A powered autocrafting terminal. Feed it storage containers and a live power feed; it assembles to spec, one operation per tick. (Assembly to spec not guaranteed during scheduled brownouts.)

The table has $(l)6$() container slots that accept $(thing)Storage Containers$(). Their combined contents become the crafting stock, aggregated across every inserted container.$(br)$(br)Refill or swap containers to keep the shelves stocked.

Open the $(thing)Pattern Encoder$() to record a recipe onto a $(thing)Blank Pattern$(). Each encoded pattern maps its inputs to an output.$(br)$(br)Up to $(l)36$() patterns can be loaded at once. The solver chains them to craft intermediate parts automatically.

Runs on FE. Buffer holds $(l)10,000 FE$(), accepts up to $(l)1,000 FE/t$().$(br)$(br)Idle draw is $(l)100 FE/t$(); each crafting operation costs $(l)200 FE$(). Starve it and the line halts until power returns.
The table exposes a peripheral to $(thing)ComputerCraft$() and $(thing)OpenComputers 2$(). Query stock and patterns, then queue crafts programmatically. See the Computers section for the method list.
